newsitem.title: USA: All American sees $68 mln in Q2 sales.
newsitem.headline: All American sees $68 mln in Q2 sales.

text.p: All American Semiconductor Inc said Monday it expected its sales to be $68 million in the second quarter ended June 30, and predicted the largest quarterly gross dollar profit in the company's history.

All American said the sales figure represented a 10 percent increase over the same period last year, when the company posted sales of $62 million, excluding $1 million in sales from discontinued operations.
Chief operating officer Bruce Goldberg said in a statement the result "represents the largest sales and gross profit dollar quarter in the company's history."
